content: असमस्त {%a.%} .²1 Incomplete, imperfect, partial, not whole. .²2 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) Not joined in a compound, not compounded. .²3 Uncollected. .²4 Separate, detached, unconnected (<ab>opp.</ab> व्यस्त). .{@-स्तम्@} An uncompounded word (the sentence showing the dissolution of a compound).
